تستخلبن (form X)
# تَسْتَخْلِبْنَ (tastaḵlibna) /tas.tax.lib.na/: second-person feminine plural non-past active indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَخْلَبَ (istaḵlaba)
# تُسْتَخْلَبْنَ (tustaḵlabna) /tus.tax.lab.na/: second-person feminine plural non-past passive indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَخْلَبَ (istaḵlaba)
